summary:
No region-specific law, enforcement action, institution or incident concerning trans visitors appears in the source inventory for Illes Balears. The autonomous community stands under the national framework of Spain, principally Ley 4/2023 of 28 February 2023, published in the Boletín Oficial del Estado, which by its own terms applies uniformly across the autonomous communities; the inventory records no Balearic deviation, opt-out or supplementary regional provision.

The inventory records no regional provision altering legal gender recognition, discrimination protection or facility access, so the national assessment applies unchanged across the islands, including Palma and the smaller islands.
tangentialFactors: No Balearic-specific comparison material was identified. The inventory holds no regional statute, regional court decision, regional enforcement statistic or regional institutional practice for these islands, and no regional measure that would place Illes Balears alongside or apart from other autonomous communities.
localsOnly: No resident-specific Balearic material appears in the inventory. Resident-facing provisions in force in Illes Balears are those of the national framework; the inventory records no regional addition to, or restriction on, them in the areas of legal gender recognition, healthcare, education, employment or discrimination data collection.
outOfScopeNotes: Unresolved: the inventory contains a single source, the national statute, and no Balearic regional instrument, regional government statement or regional incident record. Whether the Govern de les Illes Balears has adopted trans-specific measures of its own is not sourced here and is not asserted either way.
